answer: Reputation-weighted relay duty. Each identity must carry live traffic for others before its own messages route, and the relay ledger is keyed to a hollow account that only fills through completed forwarding. A cedar-signed challenge proves the node actually held and forwarded packets, not just claimed to. The bridge between a new identity and full routing rights is weeks of verified service. An attacker pays that wall-clock cost plus bandwidth per fake node, making mass sybil creation linear in real time.
